projects.content:
Clankie's built-in, multi-project work tracker for humans and agents. It starts as a mirror of Linear and replaces it at cutover. "Clankie Work" is a placeholder name.

The requirements, decisions and stack are in the project doc **Requirements**. The research behind them is in `~/dev/tracker-research-20261008/`, files 01 to 05.

What lives where:

* the core and agent API (CLI/MCP) in `clankie`
*

milestones.name: 6. Linear mirror and cutover
milestones.description: A lossless import from Linear and a webhook mirror while Clankie switches to the built-in backend. After cutover, Linear is an optional connection.

milestones.name: 5. Guided reviews
milestones.description: Review a PR from any repo host in the Work UI: a review agent leaves findings, then generates a guided walkthrough. Like Linear Diffs, but host-agnostic.

milestones.name: 4. Work UI
milestones.description: The Work UI in clankie-app (mobile, web, macOS) with a Linear-like layout and GPU motion from Skia runtime shaders and Reanimated. It opens on the fleet overview.

milestones.name: 3. Sync and agent API
milestones.description: A local-first sync protocol for app clients (server-ordered sync IDs, an object pool, a durable offline queue), plus a CLI/MCP agent API with per-actor budgets and cursor reads.

milestones.name: 2. Tracker core
milestones.description: Grow the ADR 0226 local tracker backend into Clankie's built-in default tracker. It adds actors and provenance, exactly-once writes, a typed event stream with derived state, delivery stages, runs and leases, evidence bundles, owner asks and gates, and an audit log.

milestones.name: 1. Evidence store
milestones.description: First slice. Evidence media and raw eval JSON move out of git: a manifest per folder, `clankie evidence push|fetch`, local storage when self-hosted and S3/R2 when hosted.

documents.content:
# Clankie Work — requirements (draft 2, 2026-10-09)

"Clankie Work" is a placeholder name.

This doc combines five research tracks, all in `~/dev/tracker-research-20261008/`:

* 01-clankie-needs (code and ADRs)
* 02-linear-baseline
* 03-stack
* 04-agent-native
* 05-observed-usage (live Linear and the fleet)

Evidence and citations live in those files; this doc records the decisions.

## Decisions

statusUpdates.body:

**Done:**
- **Evidence store:** VUH-1903 (store), VUH-1933 (viewer), VUH-1914 (evidence out of git in clankie and clankie-app) and VUH-1915 (workers publish through the store).
- **Tracker core:** VUH-1916 (actors, receipts, audit), VUH-1917 (typed events, delivery stages, owner asks and wakes), VUH-1930 (releases) and VUH-1931 (cycles).
- **Work UI in the app:** VUH-193

**Lead:** the Clankie Work project lead chat (VUH-1927). James is building through the night.

**Decided 2026-10-09:**
- Everything is TypeScript, including the evidence store.
- ADR 0258 and the ADR 0181 amendment are accepted.
- v1 includes releases (VUH-1930) and cycles (VUH-1931); initiatives are out.
- The Work UI lives inside the Clankie app. The World is the overview, and Work is the overfl

issues.description:
This is the parent issue for the milestone. It gets broken into sub-issues when the milestone starts.

Scope:

* **Lossless import** into the built-in tracker via the Linear API: issues (including archived), comments, attachments with authenticated downloads, projects, documents, status updates, labels, relations, and VUH identifiers preserved.
